Your ability to set up a fully operational digital store hinges on the right infrastructure. This guide details how to deploy your digital store using Cloudflare Pages, allowing you to accept crypto payments seamlessly and for free. You will gain control over your transactions and product delivery without relying on conventional platforms. Follow these steps to build a resilient e-commerce setup tailored to your needs.
Why This Infrastructure Works When Platforms Fail

The current landscape of digital commerce is riddled with platform restrictions, particularly in regions where creators are often sidelined. By utilizing a decentralized infrastructure like Cloudflare Pages combined with NOWPayments, you eliminate dependency on third-party services that may impose fees or restrictions. This architecture empowers you to maintain full ownership of your digital assets while ensuring that your store remains operational regardless of conventional barriers. When platforms fail, your sovereign infrastructure prevails, allowing you to engage directly with your audience.
What You Need Before You Deploy

Prior to deployment, ensure you have the necessary components for your digital store. You will need a Cloudflare account, a GitHub account for hosting your website, and access to NOWPayments for crypto transaction processing. Additionally, prepare your digital products for upload, whether they are ebooks, courses, or software. Familiarize yourself with Google Apps Script, which will handle backend logic. This foundational setup is critical to ensure a smooth deployment and operation of your digital store.
Setting Up Your Payment and Delivery Pipeline

Establishing your payment and delivery pipeline is crucial for your digital store. Start by configuring NOWPayments, which allows you to accept over 300 cryptocurrencies with minimal fees. Integrate it with your backend logic through Google Apps Script to automate order processing. Set up Google Drive or Cloudflare R2 for seamless file delivery upon payment confirmation. This ensures customers instantly receive their purchased products, enhancing their experience and boosting your credibility as a seller.
Embrace infrastructure sovereignty with Cloudflare Pages and NOWPayments.
Going Live and Processing Your First Transaction

Once your digital store is configured, it’s time to go live. Deploy your site on Cloudflare Pages and test the payment process using NOWPayments. Conduct a trial transaction to ensure everything functions correctly, from payment verification to product delivery. Monitor the entire process to identify and resolve any potential issues. Once confirmed, promote your store to attract customers. Utilize social media and other platforms to reach your audience and begin generating revenue.
Scaling Once the Infrastructure Is Running

After successfully launching your digital store, focus on scaling your efforts. With Cloudflare Pages and NOWPayments, you can effortlessly add new products to your inventory. Consider upgrading to the Edge Commerce Stack if you need advanced features such as SPF/DKIM/DMARC configuration for enhanced security and email deliverability. Continuously analyze your sales data to understand customer preferences and adjust your offerings accordingly. This will help you grow your business sustainably without the limitations imposed by traditional platforms.
How do I build a digital store that accepts crypto payments for free?

The setup sequence matters because each component depends on the previous one being correctly configured. Start with NOWPayments: create your account, configure wallet addresses for each coin you want to accept, generate the API key, and note the IPN secret key you will set. Then configure the backend: in Stack 01, deploy the Google Apps Script Web App and note its URL; in Stack 02, deploy the Cloudflare Worker and note its URL. Set that URL as the webhook endpoint in your NOWPayments IPN settings. Then configure the storefront. Then run a real mainnet test — send actual crypto to your configured wallet address, confirm NOWPayments detects it, confirm the webhook fires, and confirm the delivery email arrives with a working download link.
Your digital store can run independently of traditional payment platforms.

Both result in the same ownership structure: your GitHub or Cloudflare account, your Supabase database, your NOWPayments account, your wallet, your store. See both options at https://coremerch.github.io/products.html.
Your Deployment Checklist

Create a Cloudflare account and a GitHub account. Prepare your digital products for upload. Set up NOWPayments for crypto processing. Configure Google Drive or Cloudflare R2 for file delivery. Write backend logic using Google Apps Script. Deploy your site on Cloudflare Pages. Test payment processing with NOWPayments. Monitor transaction flow and product delivery. Promote your digital store to attract customers.
